steps.name: Bash
steps.input:
cd "<sandbox>" && python3 -I -c "
import gzip
rows=[]
for line in gzip.open('data/even.report.gz','rt'):
    f=line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
    if len(f)<6: continue
    if f[3]=='S': rows.append((int(f[1]), f[5].strip()))
tot=sum(r for r,_ in rows)
print('total species reads',tot,'n',len(rows))
for r,n in rows:
    print(f'{100*r/tot:8.4f}  {r:8d}  {n.lower()}')
"
